name: living-pixel-diorama
description: Living pixel-art ecosystems desktop wallpaper for Wallpaper Engine and local-first browser new tab with Unified Hybrid Liquid Glass UI.

scripts.test: node scripts/build-css.mjs && node build.mjs && node scripts/build-wallpaper.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs

scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.162.0 deploy --dry-run
